scheme_name: Proposed one-time settlement of pending transport fines
note: Maharashtra's transport department proposed a one-time settlement in August 2025: two- and three-wheeler owners would pay 25% of pending dues (effectively a 75% waiver), with a 50% waiver for violations cleared within 15 days, and smaller waivers for costlier vehicles, against roughly ₹2,500 crore outstanding statewide (₹1,817 crore in Mumbai alone since 2020). As of 1 October 2026 this remains a proposal under review by the Transport Secretary — no government order has been issued, so no discount is actually available. Until one is, the only settlement route is a National Lok Adalat sitting.
